title: DevMetricsToolkit
description: Developer-friendly server diagnostics (TPS, MSPT, memory, entities).
body:
# DevMetricsToolkit

Developer-friendly server diagnostics (TPS, MSPT, memory, entities).

## Features
- TPS and MSPT reporting.
- Memory usage and uptime.
- Entity count per world.
- Lightweight admin tool.

## Command
- `/devstats | /devmetrics reload`

## Permissions
- `devmetrics.use`
- `devmetrics.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
prefix: "&6[DevMetrics] "
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
